schema_documentation:
15 keys, all present in 100% of records; two of them are typed str-or-float because pandas NaN was serialised as a JSON float.

| key | type | presence | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `text` | str | 100% | the review body — **primary training field** |
| `id number` | int | 100% | sequential 0-148,794 |
| `greek title` | str | 100% | Greek film title (repeats per film) |
| `original title` | str **or float NaN** | 68.9% str, 46,290 NaN | foreign-language title; NaN for Greek productions |
| `category` | str | 100% | genre, 41 distinct values (Δραματική, Περιπέτεια, Κωμωδία, …) |
| `director` | str | 100% | director name(s), Greek transliteration |
| `movie lenght` | int | 100% | runtime, 0 for 325 records (sic, misspelled key) |
| `movie date` | int | 100% | film year 1921-2021 |
| `author` | str **or float NaN** | 93.9% str, 9,142 NaN | reviewer pseudonym |
| `review date` | int | 100% | 2002 (16,174) … 2021 (1,095) |
| `stars` | str | 100% | `"4 αστεράκΑ"` — 11 enum values, note the corrupted suffix |
| `label` | float | 100% | 0.0-5.0 in 0.5 steps, mirrors `stars` |
| `mean of stars` | float | 100% | per-film average |
| `number of reviews` | int | 100% | per-film review count (1-679) |
| `url` | str | 100% | athinorama movie page, 18,264 distinct |
semantic_meaning: 148,795 user-written Greek film reviews from athinorama.gr (2002-2021) with movie metadata and 0-5 star ratings.
